description.en: This is Sinai with the lights on. Your quad bike kicks up sand as you race across golden dunes toward the Valley of Echo — stand there and shout, and the mountains shout back. Catch your breath with sweet Bedouin tea in a real desert tent, then swap engines for a camel and ride it back across the sand like the Bedouin have for centuries. Go at sunset and the desert turns gold, then pink, then puts on a whole show: a VIP Bedouin dinner under the stars with Tanoura dancers spinning fire. Sinai doesn't get more alive than this.
description.ar: دي سيناء من غير أي تجميل. الكواد بتاعك بيرفع الرمل وانت بتجري وسط الكثبان الذهبية لحد وادي الصدى — قف هناك واصرخ، والجبال ترد عليك. خد نفسك مع كاس شاي بدوي حقيقي في خيمة وسط الصحراء، وبعدين بدّل المحرك بجمل واركبه زي ما البدو بيعملوا من مئات السنين. لو رحت وقت الغروب، الصحراء بتتلون دهب وبعدين وردي، وبعدها عرض كامل: عشاء بدوي VIP تحت النجوم مع رقص التنورة والنار. سيناء مفيهاش حياة أكتر من كده.

shortDescription.en: Rip across the dunes on a quad bike, shout into the Valley of Echo, and ride a camel home through the desert — Sinai's wild side in one afternoon.
shortDescription.ar: اتحرك على الكواد وسط الكثبان، اصرخ في وادي الصدى واسمع صوتك يرجعلك، واركب جمل في رحلة العودة وسط الصحراء — سيناء بوجهها البري في عصرية واحدة.

description.en: Timing is everything with this one. description.en: Your evening starts on a camel, swaying through the dunes as the sky turns orange, then pink, then dark. In a Bedouin village, dinner is already on the fire — a real open barbecue, fresh bread, and sweet tea poured the traditional way. The night closes with drums, a Tanoura dancer spinning in color, and a fire show that lights up the whole desert.

description.en: The Colored Canyon earns its name the second you step inside — sandstone walls in bands of yellow, purple, red and gold rise around you as you walk through a narrow 800-meter passage carved by water over thousands of years. From there it's a camel ride along the coast, a swim and snorkel at the Three Pools, and free time in Dahab's relaxed bazaar before the drive back. One day, three different Sinais.
description.ar: الكانيون الملوّن بياخد اسمه من أول ما تخطّى الداخل — جبال رملية بخطوط صفرا وبنفسجي وأحمر ودهبي حواليك وانت بتمشي في ممر ضيق طوله 800 متر شكلته المية على مدار آلاف السنين. بعد كده ركوبة جمل على الساحل، وعوم وسنوركل في البحيرات التلاتة، ووقت فاضي في سوق دهب الهادي قبل العودة. يوم واحد بس 3 أوجه مختلفة لسيناء.

shortDescription.en: Walk between canyon walls striped yellow, purple and gold, then swim and relax in Dahab's famous waters.

Climb onto a camel and sway slowly across the open sand with the Sinai mountains all around, or if you'd rather trot than sway, take the horse trail instead. No experience needed, no rush — just you, the desert, and one of the oldest ways of moving through it.

description.en: Ras Mohammed isn't just a dive spot — it's one of the most protected stretches of reef in the world, and today you get to float above it. Your boat makes two stops inside the national park so you can snorkel over coral walls dropping into deep blue, then heads to White Island — a sandbank so white and so empty it feels like you've found it yourself. Lunch is a real buffet on deck, drinks keep coming, and the only decision left is which reef to jump back into.
description.ar: رأس محمد مش بس مكان للغطس — هي من أكتر مناطق الشعاب المحمية في العالم، واليوم ده هتعدّي فوقها عايم. المركب بيقف مرتين جوه المحمية عشان تعمل سنوركل فوق جدران شعاب بتنزل لعمق أزرق غامق، وبعدين يروح لجزيرة النخيل البيضاء — جزيرة رملية بيضاء وفاضية حاسس إنك انت اللي اكتشفتها. الغداء بوفيه حقيقي على السطح، والمشروبات مستمرة، والقرار الوحيد الفاضل أنهي شعبة ترجع تنزل فيها.

shortDescription.en: A full day on the Red Sea — two snorkel stops inside a national park, a walk on a sandbank island that looks lifted from a postcard, lunch on deck.
shortDescription.ar: يوم كامل في البحر الأحمر — وقفتين سنوركل وسط محمية طبيعية، ونزلة على جزيرة رملية بيضاء شكلها زي الكارت بوستال، وغداء على سطح المركب.

description.en: Four hours, one boat, and the whole bay lighting up around you. Dinner is a real spread — seafood, grilled meat, chicken, all the sides — served as you sail off Sharm's coast at sunset. Then the entertainment starts: jugglers, a spinning Tanoura dancer, an oriental show that gets everyone clapping. Tell us if someone's celebrating a birthday — we'll make sure the night remembers it too.
description.ar: 4 ساعات، مركب واحد، والخليج كله بيولع حواليك. العشاء سفرة حقيقية — مأكولات بحرية، لحوم مشوية، فراخ، وكل التوابل — بتتقدّم وانت ماشي في البحر وقت الغروب على ساحل شرم. وبعدين السهرة تبدأ: ألعاب خفة، رقصة تنورة بتلف، وعرض شرقي يخلي الكل يصفّق. قولنا لو حد في عيد ميلاده — هنخلي الليلة تفتكره هي كمان.

shortDescription.en: Dinner on deck, the city lights coming on, and a live Tanoura and oriental show — a night out on the water.

description.en: No wetsuit, no snorkel, no getting wet at all — just lean over the glass floor and watch an entire coral world drift beneath you. The boat glides over some of the area's best-known reef spots while you sit back on the upper deck between looks, sun on your face, sea breeze doing the rest. An easy hour for anyone, any age, who wants to see the reef without diving into it.

description.en: Ras Mohammed packs a lot into one morning. You snorkel over coral in water so clear it barely looks real, walk through a quiet mangrove forest, float on your back in the salty Magic Lake without even trying, and climb a short cliff for a view of the Earth Crack and the coast stretching out below. All of it before lunchtime, all of it inside one of Egypt's most protected parks.
description.ar: رأس محمد بتحشر حاجات كتير في صباح واحد. تعمل سنوركل فوق شعاب في مية صافية بشكل مش حقيقي، تتمشى وسط غابة مانجروف هادية، تعوم على ظهرك في البحيرة الساحرة المالحة من غير أي تعب، وتطلع جرف صغير عشان تشوف الشق الأرضي والساحل مادد تحتك. كل ده قبل الغداء، وكل ده جوه واحدة من أكتر محميات مصر حماية.

shortDescription.en: Snorkel the park's clear water, walk through mangroves, float in the Magic Lake, and climb to the cliff view — half a day, four different worlds.

name.en: Cairo by Road: Museum, Lunch & Pyramids

description.en: It's a long day, and the first thing to know is that it's worth it. An Egyptologist walks you through the Egyptian Museum's highlights — Tutankhamun's treasures included — before lunch with a view of the Nile. Then it's the Giza Plateau: the Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure standing exactly where they've stood for 4,500 years, and the Great Sphinx watching over all of them. The ride home is long, but you'll be too busy going through your photos to notice.

name.en: Cairo in a Day, by Air

description.en: An early flight gets you to Cairo while most people are still asleep, and your English-speaking guide is waiting the moment you land. The Egyptian Museum comes first, then lunch with the Nile in view, a stop at a perfume workshop, and the Giza Plateau — the Pyramids, the Sphinx, and a papyrus institute before the flight back. description.en: There's a reason people have climbed this mountain for thousands of years. You'll start in the dark, guided up the path by lantern and starlight, and reach the summit just as the sky turns — first grey, then gold, then a view across the whole Sinai Peninsula that no photo does justice to. On the way down, St. Catherine's Monastery is waiting: a living community of monks, a library of ancient manuscripts, and walls that have stood since the 6th century. This is Sinai's spiritual heart, and you'll earn the view.
